share_image_alt: Human AI Orientation: a free course in four steps. Try AI on a useful task, give AI useful context, save and reuse context, then check, improve and continue.

pages.description: Optional practice: use your own AI tool beside your notes. Copy, switch windows, paste and come back.
Optional practice: find your way around files, folders and locations, so you can give an AI the right material and find what it makes.
Optional practice: keep your goals, useful background and checked results in your own notes, so you can reuse them with any AI.
Optional next steps: free courses and short videos about working with AI, with a suggestion for where to start.
An optional early reading for Unit 2: what an AI agent on your computer is, and the plain-text instruction files that agent tools read.
What personal information Human AI Orientation collects, why, and the choices you have.
Give your own AI a short, public description of this course, so it can help you work through it.
